name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q01 - Standard cell emf of copper silver cell

questiontext.text:
Given the standard reduction potentials: \(E^\circ(\mathrm{Ag}^+/\mathrm{Ag}) = +0.80\text{ V}\) and \(E^\circ(\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}/\mathrm{Cu}) = +0.34\text{ V}\). What is the standard electromotive force (\(E^\circ_{\text{cell}}\)) for the cell reaction \(\mathrm{Cu(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag}^+(\text{aq}) \rightarrow \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{Ag(s)}\)?

दिए गए मानक अपचयन विभव हैं: \(E^\circ(\mathrm{Ag}^+/\\mathrm{Ag}) = +0.80\text{ V}\) तथा \(E^\circ(\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}/\mathrm{Cu}) = +0.34\text{ V}\)। सेल अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{Cu(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag}^+(\text{aq}) \rightarrow \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{Ag(s)}\) के लिए मानक विद्युत वाहक बल (\(E^\circ_{\text{cell}}\)) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Identify cathode and anode half-reactions: Silver ion undergoes reduction at cathode with \(E^\circ_{\text{cathode}} = +0.80\text{ V}\). Copper undergoes oxidation at anode with \(E^\circ_{\text{anode}} = +0.34\text{ V}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
कैथोड और एनोड की अर्ध-अभिक्रियाओं की पहचान: कैथोड पर सिल्वर आयन का अपचयन होता है (\(E^\circ_{\text{cathode}} = +0.80\text{ V}\)) तथा एनोड पर कॉपर का ऑक्सीकरण होता है (\(E^\circ_{\text{anode}} = +0.34\text{ V}\))।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate standard cell emf: \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cathode}} - E^\circ_{\text{anode}} = +0.80\text{ V} - (+0.34\text{ V}) = +0.46\text{ V}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
मानक सेल विभव की गणना: \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cathode}} - E^\circ_{\text{anode}} = +0.80\text{ V} - 0.34\text{ V} = +0.46\text{ V}\)।

Conclusion:
The standard cell potential is \(+0.46\text{ V}\).
मानक सेल विभव \(+0.46\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q02 - Charge required for aluminium reduction

questiontext.text:
How much electrical charge in Coulombs is required for the complete reduction of \(1\text{ mole}\) of \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) to \(\mathrm{Al}\)? (Take \(1\text{ F} = 96500\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

\(1\text{ मोल}\) \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) को \(\mathrm{Al}\) में पूर्ण रूप से अपचित करने के लिए कितने कूलॉम वैद्युत आवेश की आवश्यकता होगी? (\(1\text{ F} = 96500\text{ C mol}^{-1}\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Electrode stoichiometry: The reduction reaction is \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+} + 3\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \mathrm{Al(s)}\). Reduction of \(1\text{ mol}\) of \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) requires \(3\text{ moles of electrons}\) (\(3\text{ F}\)).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
इलेक्ट्रोड रससमीकरणमिति: अपचयन अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+} + 3\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \mathrm{Al(s)}\) है। \(1\text{ मोल}\) \(\mathrm{Al}^{3+}\) के लिए \(3\text{ मोल}\) इलेक्ट्रॉनों (\(3\text{ F}\)) की आवश्यकता होती है।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate total charge: \(Q = nF = 3\text{ mol} \times 96500\text{ C mol}^{-1} = 289500\text{ C} = 2.895 \times 10^5\text{ C}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
कुल आवेश की गणना: \(Q = 3 \times 96500\text{ C} = 2.895 \times 10^5\text{ C}\)।

Conclusion:
The charge required is \(2.895 \times 10^5\text{ C}\).
आवश्यक कुल आवेश \(2.895 \times 10^5\text{ C}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q03 - Cell constant determination from standard KCl

questiontext.text:
The resistance of a conductivity cell filled with \(0.1\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) solution is \(100\ \Omega\). If the conductivity of \(0.1\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) solution at the same temperature is \(1.29\text{ S m}^{-1}\), what is the cell constant?

\(0.1\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) विलयन से भरे एक चालकता सेल का प्रतिरोध \(100\ \Omega\) है। यदि उसी ताप पर \(0.1\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) विलयन की चालकता \(1.29\text{ S m}^{-1}\) है, तो सेल स्थिरांक का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Formula: Cell constant \(G^* = \frac{l}{A} = \kappa \times R\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
सूत्र: सेल स्थिरांक \(G^* = \kappa \times R\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate value: \(G^* = 1.29\text{ S m}^{-1} \times 100\ \Omega = 129\text{ m}^{-1}\). In centimeters: \(129\text{ m}^{-1} = 1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
मान की गणना: \(G^* = 1.29\text{ S m}^{-1} \times 100\ \Omega = 129\text{ m}^{-1}\) (अथवा \(1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}\))।

Conclusion:
The cell constant is \(129\text{ m}^{-1}\) (or \(1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}\)).
सेल स्थिरांक \(129\text{ m}^{-1}\) (या \(1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}\)) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q04 - Charge required to reduce dichromate ion

questiontext.text:
Consider the reaction: \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-} + 14\mathrm{H}^+ + 6\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow 2\mathrm{Cr}^{3+} + 7\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}\). What is the quantity of electricity in Coulombs needed to reduce \(1\text{ mol}\) of \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-}\)? (Take \(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

अभिक्रिया पर विचार कीजिए: \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-} + 14\mathrm{H}^+ + 6\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow 2\mathrm{Cr}^{3+} + 7\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O}\)। \(1\text{ मोल}\) \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-}\) को अपचित करने के लिए कितने कूलॉम विद्युत की आवश्यकता होगी? (\(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Stoichiometry: The balanced half-equation shows that reduction of \(1\text{ mol}\) of \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-}\) requires \(6\text{ moles of electrons}\) (\(n = 6\)).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
रससमीकरणमिति: संतुलित अर्ध-समीकरण से स्पष्ट है कि \(1\text{ मोल}\) \(\mathrm{Cr}_2\mathrm{O}_7^{2-}\) के अपचयन हेतु \(6\text{ मोल}\) इलेक्ट्रॉनों (\(n = 6\)) की आवश्यकता होती है।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate total electricity: \(Q = 6 \times 96487\text{ C} = 578922\text{ C} \approx 5.79 \times 10^5\text{ C}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
कुल विद्युत आवेश: \(Q = 6 \times 96487\text{ C} = 578922\text{ C} \approx 5.79 \times 10^5\text{ C}\)।

Conclusion:
The quantity of electricity needed is \(5.79 \times 10^5\text{ C}\).
आवश्यक विद्युत की मात्रा \(5.79 \times 10^5\text{ C}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q05 - Hydrogen electrode potential at pH 10

questiontext.text:
What is the reduction potential of a hydrogen electrode in contact with a solution of \(\text{pH} = 10\) at \(298\text{ K}\) under \(1\text{ bar}\) \(\mathrm{H}_2\) pressure?

\(1\text{ bar}\) \(\mathrm{H}_2\) दाब पर \(298\text{ K}\) पर \(\text{pH} = 10\) वाले विलयन के संपर्क में स्थित हाइड्रोजन इलेक्ट्रोड का अपचयन विभव क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Find hydrogen ion concentration: Given \(\text{pH} = 10\), \([\mathrm{H}^+] = 10^{-10}\text{ M}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
हाइड्रोजन आयन सांद्रता ज्ञात करना: \(\text{pH} = 10\) से \([\mathrm{H}^+] = 10^{-10}\text{ M}\) प्राप्त होता है।

Step 2 (English):
Nernst equation for half-reaction: For \(\mathrm{H}^+(\text{aq}) + \mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{H}_2(\text{g})\), \(E = E^\circ - \frac{0.0591}{1}\log\frac{1}{[\mathrm{H}^+]} = 0.00 - 0.0591 \log(10^{10}) = -0.0591 \times 10 = -0.591\text{ V}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
नेर्नस्ट समीकरण: \(\mathrm{H}^+ + \mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{H}_2\) के लिए, \(E = 0 - 0.0591 \log(10^{10}) = -0.591\text{ V}\)।

Conclusion:
The reduction potential is \(-0.591\text{ V}\).
अपचयन विभव \(-0.591\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q06 - Daniell cell emf with unequal concentrations

questiontext.text:
Calculate the emf of the Daniell cell \(\mathrm{Zn(s)} \mid \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(0.1\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(0.01\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Cu(s)}\) at \(298\text{ K}\), given \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.10\text{ V}\).

\(298\text{ K}\) पर डेनियल सेल \(\mathrm{Zn(s)} \mid \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(0.1\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(0.01\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Cu(s)}\) का विद्युत वाहक बल ज्ञात कीजिए, यदि \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.10\text{ V}\) है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Cell reaction and quotient: \(\mathrm{Zn(s)} + \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(\text{aq}) \rightarrow \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + \mathrm{Cu(s)}\) with \(n = 2\). Reaction quotient \(Q = \frac{[\mathrm{Zn}^{2+}]}{[\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}]} = \frac{0.1}{0.01} = 10\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
सेल अभिक्रिया एवं भागफल: \(n = 2\) तथा अभिक्रिया भागफल \(Q = \frac{0.1}{0.01} = 10\)।

Step 2 (English):
Apply Nernst equation: \(E_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{cell}} - \frac{0.0591}{2}\log Q = 1.10 - 0.02955 \log 10 = 1.10 - 0.02955 \approx 1.07\text{ V}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
नेर्नस्ट समीकरण का अनुप्रयोग: \(E_{\text{cell}} = 1.10 - \frac{0.0591}{2}\log 10 = 1.10 - 0.02955 \approx 1.07\text{ V}\)।

Conclusion:
The operating cell electromotive force is \(1.07\text{ V}\).
सेल का विद्युत वाहक बल \(1.07\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q07 - Mass of copper deposited during electrolysis

questiontext.text:
A steady current of \(1.5\text{ A}\) is passed through a solution of \(\mathrm{CuSO}_4\) for \(10\text{ minutes}\). What mass of copper is deposited at the cathode? (Atomic mass of \(\mathrm{Cu} = 63.5\text{ g mol}^{-1}\), \(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

\(\mathrm{CuSO}_4\) के विलयन में \(1.5\text{ A}\) की स्थिर धारा \(10\text{ मिनट}\) के लिए प्रवाहित की जाती है। कैथोड पर निक्षेपित कॉपर का द्रव्यमान क्या होगा? (\(\mathrm{Cu}\) का परमाणु द्रव्यमान \(= 63.5\text{ g mol}^{-1}\), \(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate total charge passed: \(Q = I \times t = 1.5\text{ A} \times (10 \times 60\text{ s}) = 900\text{ C}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
प्रवाहित कुल आवेश: \(Q = 1.5 \times 600 = 900\text{ C}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Electrochemical equivalent and mass calculation: \(\mathrm{Cu}^{2+} + 2\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \mathrm{Cu(s)}\) (\(n = 2\)). \(m = \frac{M \times Q}{nF} = \frac{63.5 \times 900}{2 \times 96487} = \frac{57150}{192974} \approx 0.296\text{ g}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
निक्षेपित द्रव्यमान: \(m = \frac{63.5 \times 900}{2 \times 96487} \approx 0.296\text{ g}\)।

Conclusion:
The mass of copper deposited is \(0.296\text{ g}\).
निक्षेपित कॉपर का द्रव्यमान \(0.296\text{ g}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q08 - Molar conductivity of KCl solution

questiontext.text:
A conductivity cell with cell constant \(1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}\) has a resistance of \(520\ \Omega\) when filled with \(0.02\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) solution. What is the molar conductivity (\(\Lambda_m\)) of this solution?

एक चालकता सेल जिसका सेल स्थिरांक \(1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}\) है, \(0.02\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{KCl}\) विलयन से भरे होने पर \(520\ \Omega\) प्रतिरोध दर्शाता है। इस विलयन की मोलर चालकता (\(\Lambda_m\)) क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate conductivity: \(\kappa = \frac{G^*}{R} = \frac{1.29\text{ cm}^{-1}}{520\ \Omega} \approx 2.48 \times 10^{-3}\text{ S cm}^{-1}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
चालकता की गणना: \(\kappa = \frac{1.29}{520} \approx 2.48 \times 10^{-3}\text{ S cm}^{-1}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate molar conductivity: \(\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \times 1000}{c} = \frac{2.48 \times 10^{-3} \times 1000}{0.02} = \frac{2.48}{0.02} = 124\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
मोलर चालकता की गणना: \(\Lambda_m = \frac{2.48 \times 10^{-3} \times 1000}{0.02} = 124\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\)।

Conclusion:
The molar conductivity is \(124\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\).
मोलर चालकता \(124\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q09 - Kohlrausch calculation for acetic acid

questiontext.text:
Given the limiting molar conductivities at \(298\text{ K}\): \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{NaCl}) = 126.4\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\), \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{HCl}) = 425.9\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\), and \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{COONa}) = 91.0\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\). What is \(\Lambda_m^\circ\) for acetic acid?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर सीमांत मोलर चालकताएं दी गई हैं: \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{NaCl}) = 126.4\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\), \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{HCl}) = 425.9\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\), तथा \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{COONa}) = 91.0\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\)। एसिटिक अम्ल के लिए \(\Lambda_m^\circ\) का मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Apply Kohlrausch's law: \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{COOH}) = \Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{COONa}) + \Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{HCl}) - \Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{NaCl})\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
कोलराउश नियम का अनुप्रयोग: \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{COOH}) = \Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{CH}_3\mathrm{COONa}) + \Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{HCl}) - \Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{NaCl})\)।

Step 2 (English):
Substitute values: \(\Lambda_m^\circ = 91.0 + 425.9 - 126.4 = 516.9 - 126.4 = 390.5\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
मान प्रतिस्थापित करने पर: \(\Lambda_m^\circ = 91.0 + 425.9 - 126.4 = 390.5\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\)।

Conclusion:
The limiting molar conductivity of acetic acid is \(390.5\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\).
एसिटिक अम्ल की सीमांत मोलर चालकता \(390.5\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q10 - Number of electrons from current and time

questiontext.text:
If a current of \(0.5\text{ A}\) flows through a metallic wire for \(2\text{ hours}\), how many electrons pass through the wire? (Elementary charge \(e = 1.602 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}\))

यदि किसी धात्विक तार में \(0.5\text{ A}\) की विद्युत धारा \(2\text{ घंटे}\) तक प्रवाहित होती है, तो तार में से कितने इलेक्ट्रॉन प्रवाहित होंगे? (मूल आवेश \(e = 1.602 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate total charge passed: \(Q = I \times t = 0.5\text{ A} \times (2 \times 3600\text{ s}) = 0.5 \times 7200 = 3600\text{ C}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
प्रवाहित कुल आवेश: \(Q = 0.5 \times 7200 = 3600\text{ C}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate number of electrons: \(N = \frac{Q}{e} = \frac{3600\text{ C}}{1.602 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}} \approx 2.247 \times 10^{22} \approx 2.25 \times 10^{22}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या: \(N = \frac{3600}{1.602 \times 10^{-19}} \approx 2.25 \times 10^{22}\)।

Conclusion:
The number of electrons passing through the wire is \(2.25 \times 10^{22}\).
प्रवाहित इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या \(2.25 \times 10^{22}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q11 - Standard Gibbs energy change calculation

questiontext.text:
The cell reaction \(2\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{I}^-(\text{aq}) \rightarrow 2\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + \mathrm{I}_2(\text{s})\) has \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 0.236\text{ V}\) at \(298\text{ K}\). What is the standard Gibbs energy change (\(\Delta_r G^\circ\))? (Take \(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

अभिक्रिया \(2\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{I}^-(\text{aq}) \rightarrow 2\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + \mathrm{I}_2(\text{s})\) के लिए \(298\text{ K}\) पर \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 0.236\text{ V}\) है। मानक गिब्ज़ ऊर्जा परिवर्तन (\(\Delta_r G^\circ\)) क्या होगा? (\(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Identify moles of electrons transferred: Reduction of \(2\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}\) to \(2\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}\) involves \(n = 2\) moles of electrons.

Step 1 (हिंदी):
इलेक्ट्रॉनों के मोल की संख्या: \(2\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}\) से \(2\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}\) में \(n = 2\) मोल इलेक्ट्रॉन स्थानांतरित होते हैं।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate standard Gibbs free energy: \(\Delta_r G^\circ = -nFE^\circ_{\text{cell}} = -2 \times 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1} \times 0.236\text{ V} = -45541.86\text{ J mol}^{-1} \approx -45.54\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
मानक गिब्ज़ ऊर्जा परिवर्तन: \(\Delta_r G^\circ = -nFE^\circ_{\text{cell}} = -2 \times 96487 \times 0.236 = -45.54\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\)।

Conclusion:
The standard Gibbs energy change is \(-45.54\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\).
मानक गिब्ज़ ऊर्जा परिवर्तन \(-45.54\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q12 - Resistivity and conductivity of NaOH column

questiontext.text:
A cylindrical column of \(0.05\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{NaOH}\) solution of diameter \(1\text{ cm}\) and length \(50\text{ cm}\) has an electrical resistance of \(5.55 \times 10^3\ \Omega\). What is the conductivity (\(\kappa\)) of this solution?

\(1\text{ cm}\) व्यास तथा \(50\text{ cm}\) लंबाई वाले \(0.05\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) \(\mathrm{NaOH}\) विलयन के एक बेलनाकार स्तंभ का वैद्युत प्रतिरोध \(5.55 \times 10^3\ \Omega\) है। इस विलयन की चालकता (\(\kappa\)) क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate cross-sectional area: Radius \(r = 0.5\text{ cm}\). Area \(A = \pi r^2 = 3.1416 \times (0.5)^2 = 0.7854\text{ cm}^2\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
अनुप्रस्थ काट क्षेत्रफल: त्रिज्या \(r = 0.5\text{ cm}\), \(A = \pi r^2 = 0.7854\text{ cm}^2\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate resistivity and conductivity: \(\rho = \frac{R A}{l} = \frac{5550 \times 0.7854}{50} = 87.18\ \Omega\text{ cm}\). Conductivity \(\kappa = \frac{1}{\rho} = \frac{1}{87.18} \approx 0.01148\text{ S cm}^{-1} \approx 1.148\text{ S m}^{-1}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
प्रतिरोधकता एवं चालकता: \(\rho = \frac{5550 \times 0.7854}{50} = 87.18\ \Omega\text{ cm}\)। चालकता \(\kappa = \frac{1}{\rho} \approx 0.01148\text{ S cm}^{-1}\) (या \(1.148\text{ S m}^{-1}\))।

Conclusion:
The conductivity is \(0.01148\text{ S cm}^{-1}\) (or \(1.148\text{ S m}^{-1}\)).
चालकता \(0.01148\text{ S cm}^{-1}\) (अथवा \(1.148\text{ S m}^{-1}\)) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q13 - Equilibrium constant of copper silver reaction

questiontext.text:
Calculate the equilibrium constant (\(K_c\)) of the reaction \(\mathrm{Cu(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag}^+(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{Ag(s)}\) at \(298\text{ K}\), given \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 0.46\text{ V}\).

\(298\text{ K}\) पर अभिक्रिया \(\mathrm{Cu(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag}^+(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{Ag(s)}\) के लिए साम्य स्थिरांक (\(K_c\)) का परिकलन कीजिए, यदि \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 0.46\text{ V}\) है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Formula relating E°cell and Kc: For \(n = 2\), \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = \frac{0.0591}{2}\log K_c\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
मानक सेल विभव तथा साम्य स्थिरांक में संबंध: \(n = 2\) के लिए, \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = \frac{0.0591}{2}\log K_c\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate log Kc and Kc: \(\log K_c = \frac{0.46 \times 2}{0.0591} = \frac{0.92}{0.0591} \approx 15.57\). Taking antilog: \(K_c = 10^{15.57} = 10^{0.57} \times 10^{15} \approx 3.92 \times 10^{15}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
\(\log K_c\) और \(K_c\) की गणना: \(\log K_c = \frac{0.92}{0.0591} \approx 15.6\)। ऐंटिलॉग लेने पर: \(K_c \approx 3.92 \times 10^{15}\)।

Conclusion:
The equilibrium constant is \(3.92 \times 10^{15}\).
साम्य स्थिरांक \(3.92 \times 10^{15}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q14 - Degree of dissociation of methanoic acid

questiontext.text:
The molar conductivity of \(0.025\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) methanoic acid (\(\mathrm{HCOOH}\)) is \(46.1\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\). Given \(\lambda^\circ(\mathrm{H}^+) = 349.6\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) and \(\lambda^\circ(\mathrm{HCOO}^-) = 54.6\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\), what is the degree of dissociation (\(\alpha\))?

\(0.025\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) मेथेनोइक अम्ल (\(\mathrm{HCOOH}\)) की मोलर चालकता \(46.1\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) है। यदि \(\lambda^\circ(\mathrm{H}^+) = 349.6\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) तथा \(\lambda^\circ(\mathrm{HCOO}^-) = 54.6\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) है, तो वियोजन की मात्रा (\(\alpha\)) क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate limiting molar conductivity: \(\Lambda_m^\circ(\mathrm{HCOOH}) = \lambda^\circ(\mathrm{H}^+) + \lambda^\circ(\mathrm{HCOO}^-) = 349.6 + 54.6 = 404.2\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
सीमित मोलर चालकता: \(\Lambda_m^\circ = 349.6 + 54.6 = 404.2\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate degree of dissociation: \(\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ} = \frac{46.1\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}}{404.2\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}} \approx 0.114\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
वियोजन की मात्रा: \(\alpha = \frac{46.1}{404.2} \approx 0.114\)।

Conclusion:
The degree of dissociation is \(0.114\).
वियोजन की मात्रा \(0.114\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q15 - Nernst emf calculation for nickel silver cell

questiontext.text:
Calculate the emf of the cell \(\mathrm{Ni(s)} \mid \mathrm{Ni}^{2+}(0.160\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Ag}^+(0.002\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Ag(s)}\) at \(298\text{ K}\), given \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.05\text{ V}\). (Take \(\log 4 = 0.602\))

\(298\text{ K}\) पर सेल \(\mathrm{Ni(s)} \mid \mathrm{Ni}^{2+}(0.160\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Ag}^+(0.002\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Ag(s)}\) का वि.वा.बल परिकलित कीजिए, यदि \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 1.05\text{ V}\) है। (\(\log 4 = 0.602\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Cell reaction and quotient: \(\mathrm{Ni(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag}^+(\text{aq}) \rightarrow \mathrm{Ni}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{Ag(s)}\) with \(n = 2\). Reaction quotient \(Q = \frac{[\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}]}{[\mathrm{Ag}^+]^2} = \frac{0.160}{(0.002)^2} = \frac{0.160}{4 \times 10^{-6}} = 4 \times 10^4\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
सेल अभिक्रिया एवं भागफल: \(n = 2\), \(Q = \frac{0.160}{(0.002)^2} = 4 \times 10^4\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate log Q and Nernst term: \(\log Q = \log(4 \times 10^4) = 4 + 0.602 = 4.602\). Correction term: \(\frac{0.0591}{2} \times 4.602 = 0.02955 \times 4.602 = 0.136\text{ V}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
\(\log Q\) और विभव में कमी: \(\log Q = 4.602\), \(\Delta E = \frac{0.0591}{2} \times 4.602 = 0.136\text{ V}\)।

Step 3 (English):
Compute cell potential: \(E_{\text{cell}} = 1.05\text{ V} - 0.136\text{ V} = 0.914\text{ V}\).

Step 3 (हिंदी):
सेल विभव की गणना: \(E_{\text{cell}} = 1.05 - 0.136 = 0.914\text{ V}\)।

Conclusion:
The cell potential is \(0.914\text{ V}\).
सेल विभव \(0.914\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q16 - Faraday series electrolysis copper deposition

questiontext.text:
Three electrolytic cells containing \(\mathrm{ZnSO}_4\), \(\mathrm{AgNO}_3\), and \(\mathrm{CuSO}_4\) are connected in series. A steady current of \(1.5\text{ A}\) was passed until \(1.45\text{ g}\) of silver was deposited. How long did the current flow, and what mass of copper was deposited? (Atomic mass: \(\mathrm{Ag} = 108\text{ g mol}^{-1}\), \(\mathrm{Cu} = 63.5\text{ g mol}^{-1}\), \(F = 96487\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

\(\mathrm{ZnSO}_4\), \(\mathrm{AgNO}_3\) और \(\mathrm{CuSO}_4\) वाले तीन वैद्युत-अपघटनी सेल श्रेणीक्रम में जुड़े हैं। \(1.5\text{ A}\) की स्थिर धारा तब तक प्रवाहित की गई जब तक कि \(1.45\text{ g}\) सिल्वर निक्षेपित न हो गया। धारा कितने समय तक प्रवाहित हुई और कितना कॉपर निक्षेपित हुआ?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate charge and time: \(\mathrm{Ag}^+ + \mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \mathrm{Ag}\). \(Q = \frac{m_{\mathrm{Ag}} \times F}{M_{\mathrm{Ag}}} = \frac{1.45 \times 96487}{108} = \frac{139906}{108} \approx 1295.4\text{ C}\). Time \(t = \frac{Q}{I} = \frac{1295.4\text{ C}}{1.5\text{ A}} \approx 863.6\text{ s} \approx 14.4\text{ min}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
आवेश एवं समय की गणना: \(Q = \frac{1.45 \times 96487}{108} \approx 1295.4\text{ C}\)। समय \(t = \frac{1295.4}{1.5} \approx 864\text{ s}\) (\(14.4\text{ मिनट}\))।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate mass of copper: By Faraday's second law, \(\frac{m_{\mathrm{Cu}}}{m_{\mathrm{Ag}}} = \frac{E_{\mathrm{Cu}}}{E_{\mathrm{Ag}}} = \frac{63.5/2}{108} = \frac{31.75}{108}\). \(m_{\mathrm{Cu}} = 1.45 \times \frac{31.75}{108} \approx 0.426\text{ g}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
कॉपर के द्रव्यमान की गणना: \(m_{\mathrm{Cu}} = 1.45 \times \frac{31.75}{108} \approx 0.426\text{ g}\)।

Conclusion:
The current flowed for approximately \(864\text{ s}\) (\(14.4\text{ min}\)) and \(0.426\text{ g}\) of copper was deposited.
धारा लगभग \(864\text{ s}\) (\(14.4\text{ मिनट}\)) तक बही और \(0.426\text{ g}\) कॉपर निक्षेपित हुआ।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q17 - Dissociation constant of weak acetic acid

questiontext.text:
The conductivity of \(0.001028\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) acetic acid is \(4.95 \times 10^{-5}\text{ S cm}^{-1}\). If \(\Lambda_m^\circ\) for acetic acid is \(390.5\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\), what is its acid dissociation constant (\(K_a\))?

\(0.001028\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) एसिटिक अम्ल की चालकता \(4.95 \times 10^{-5}\text{ S cm}^{-1}\) है। यदि इसके लिए \(\Lambda_m^\circ = 390.5\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\) हो, तो इसका वियोजन स्थिरांक (\(K_a\)) क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate molar conductivity: \(\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \times 1000}{c} = \frac{4.95 \times 10^{-5} \times 1000}{0.001028} = \frac{0.0495}{0.001028} \approx 48.15\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
मोलर चालकता: \(\Lambda_m = \frac{4.95 \times 10^{-5} \times 1000}{0.001028} \approx 48.15\text{ S cm}^2\text{ mol}^{-1}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate degree of dissociation: \(\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ} = \frac{48.15}{390.5} \approx 0.1233\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
वियोजन की मात्रा: \(\alpha = \frac{48.15}{390.5} \approx 0.1233\)।

Step 3 (English):
Calculate dissociation constant: \(K_a = \frac{c \alpha^2}{1 - \alpha} = \frac{0.001028 \times (0.1233)^2}{1 - 0.1233} = \frac{0.001028 \times 0.0152}{0.8767} \approx 1.78 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol L}^{-1}\).

Step 3 (हिंदी):
वियोजन स्थिरांक: \(K_a = \frac{0.001028 \times (0.1233)^2}{1 - 0.1233} \approx 1.78 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol L}^{-1}\)।

Conclusion:
The acid dissociation constant is \(1.78 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol L}^{-1}\).
अम्ल वियोजन स्थिरांक \(1.78 \times 10^{-5}\text{ mol L}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q18 - Magnesium silver galvanic cell operating potential

questiontext.text:
Calculate the operating emf of the cell \(\mathrm{Mg(s)} \mid \mathrm{Mg}^{2+}(0.130\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Ag}^+(0.0001\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Ag(s)}\) at \(298\text{ K}\), given \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 3.17\text{ V}\). (Take \(\log 1.3 = 0.114\))

\(298\text{ K}\) पर सेल \(\mathrm{Mg(s)} \mid \mathrm{Mg}^{2+}(0.130\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Ag}^+(0.0001\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Ag(s)}\) का वि.वा.बल परिकलित कीजिए, यदि \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 3.17\text{ V}\) है। (\(\log 1.3 = 0.114\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Cell reaction and quotient: \(\mathrm{Mg(s)} + 2\mathrm{Ag}^+(\text{aq}) \rightarrow \mathrm{Mg}^{2+}(\text{aq}) + 2\mathrm{Ag(s)}\) (\(n = 2\)). \(Q = \frac{[\mathrm{Mg}^{2+}]}{[\mathrm{Ag}^+]^2} = \frac{0.130}{(10^{-4})^2} = \frac{0.130}{10^{-8}} = 1.3 \times 10^7\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
सेल अभिक्रिया एवं भागफल: \(n = 2\), \(Q = \frac{0.130}{(10^{-4})^2} = 1.3 \times 10^7\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate log Q and Nernst term: \(\log Q = \log(1.3 \times 10^7) = 7 + 0.114 = 7.114\). Correction: \(\frac{0.0591}{2} \times 7.114 = 0.02955 \times 7.114 \approx 0.210\text{ V}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
\(\log Q\) और विभव में परिवर्तन: \(\log Q = 7.114\), \(\Delta E = \frac{0.0591}{2} \times 7.114 \approx 0.21\text{ V}\)।

Step 3 (English):
Compute cell potential: \(E_{\text{cell}} = 3.17\text{ V} - 0.210\text{ V} = 2.96\text{ V}\).

Step 3 (हिंदी):
सेल विभव की गणना: \(E_{\text{cell}} = 3.17 - 0.21 = 2.96\text{ V}\)।

Conclusion:
The cell potential is \(2.96\text{ V}\).
सेल विभव \(2.96\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q19 - Concentration cell emf calculation

questiontext.text:
A concentration cell is constructed as \(\mathrm{Zn(s)} \mid \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(0.01\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(0.1\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Zn(s)}\) at \(298\text{ K}\). What is the electromotive force of this concentration cell?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर एक सांद्रता सेल \(\mathrm{Zn(s)} \mid \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(0.01\text{ M}) \parallel \mathrm{Zn}^{2+}(0.1\text{ M}) \mid \mathrm{Zn(s)}\) बनाया गया है। इस सांद्रता सेल का विद्युत वाहक बल क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Concentration cell characteristics: Electrodes and ions are identical, so standard potential \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 0.00\text{ V}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
सांद्रता सेल के गुण: मानक विभव \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = 0.00\text{ V}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Formulate Nernst equation: Anode oxidizes dilute zinc (\(c_1 = 0.01\text{ M}\)), cathode reduces concentrated zinc (\(c_2 = 0.1\text{ M}\)). With \(n = 2\), \(E_{\text{cell}} = 0 - \frac{0.0591}{2}\log\left(\frac{c_1}{c_2}\right) = \frac{0.0591}{2}\log\left(\frac{0.1}{0.01}\right) = 0.02955 \log 10 = 0.02955\text{ V} \approx 0.0296\text{ V}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
नेर्नस्ट समीकरण: \(E_{\text{cell}} = \frac{0.0591}{2}\log\left(\frac{c_2}{c_1}\right) = \frac{0.0591}{2}\log\left(\frac{0.1}{0.01}\right) = 0.02955 \log 10 \approx 0.0296\text{ V}\)।

Conclusion:
The electromotive force is \(0.0296\text{ V}\).
विद्युत वाहक बल \(0.0296\text{ V}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_ELECTROCHEMISTRY_NUM_Q20 - Current efficiency during nickel electroplating

questiontext.text:
A current of \(2.0\text{ A}\) is passed for \(30\text{ minutes}\) through an electrolytic cell containing \(\mathrm{NiSO}_4\) solution. If \(0.95\text{ g}\) of nickel is deposited at the cathode, what is the current efficiency of the electroplating process? (Atomic mass of \(\mathrm{Ni} = 58.7\text{ g mol}^{-1}\), \(F = 96500\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

\(\mathrm{NiSO}_4\) विलयन वाले एक वैद्युत-अपघटनी सेल में \(30\text{ मिनट}\) के लिए \(2.0\text{ A}\) की धारा प्रवाहित की जाती है। यदि कैथोड पर \(0.95\text{ g}\) निकेल निक्षेपित होता है, तो विद्युत-लेपन की धारा दक्षता (current efficiency) क्या होगी? (\(\mathrm{Ni}\) का परमाणु द्रव्यमान \(= 58.7\text{ g mol}^{-1}\), \(F = 96500\text{ C mol}^{-1}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1 (English):
Calculate total charge passed: \(Q = I \times t = 2.0\text{ A} \times (30 \times 60\text{ s}) = 3600\text{ C}\).

Step 1 (हिंदी):
प्रवाहित कुल आवेश: \(Q = 2.0 \times 1800 = 3600\text{ C}\)।

Step 2 (English):
Calculate theoretical mass deposited: For \(\mathrm{Ni}^{2+} + 2\mathrm{e}^- \rightarrow \mathrm{Ni}\) (\(n = 2\)), \(m_{\text{theo}} = \frac{M \times Q}{nF} = \frac{58.7 \times 3600}{2 \times 96500} = \frac{211320}{193000} \approx 1.095\text{ g}\).

Step 2 (हिंदी):
सैद्धांतिक द्रव्यमान: \(m_{\text{theo}} = \frac{58.7 \times 3600}{2 \times 96500} \approx 1.095\text{ g}\)।

Step 3 (English):
Calculate current efficiency: \(\text{Efficiency} = \frac{m_{\text{actual}}}{m_{\text{theo}}} \times 100\% = \frac{0.95\text{ g}}{1.095\text{ g}} \times 100\% \approx 86.8\%\).

Step 3 (हिंदी):
धारा दक्षता की गणना: \(\text{दक्षता} = \frac{0.95}{1.095} \times 100\% \approx 86.8\%\)।

Conclusion:
The current efficiency is approximately \(86.8\%\).
धारा दक्षता लगभग \(86.8\%\) है।
